title: Pure Toon
summary: Toon cards with Cartoon Shade, The Black Stone of Legend and generic staples. The page's older combo lines add Synchron, Charmer and Link engines, and its Horned Saurus line adds Kaitoptera and Sorcerer of the Swamp, so they use cards this list leaves out; its Bookmark and Black Stone lines run on this list. Toon World the Perfect World is OCG-only. Toon Kingdom counts as Toon World and protects your Toons. The Black Stone of Legend summons Red-Eyes Toon Dragon, which then summons any Toon from the hand. Cartoon Shade, the newest card, summons itself next to a monster that can't be Normal Summoned, searches Toon Dark Magician Girl, and bounces two cards when it's Tributed.

allow.The Black Stone of Legend: Red-Eyes Toon Dragon is a Red-Eyes monster, so it summons it from the Deck: the page's Black Stone Starter.
